title: Downtown Skyline Views · Huge Rooftop · Sleeps 10
description:
Wake up to skyline views and end your nights on a massive private rooftop overlooking downtown Nashville.

This modern townhome sleeps up to 10 guests, making it perfect for groups, families, and weekend getaways. Enjoy a huge rooftop lounge with sectional seating and an outdoor TV, an open living space, and spa-style comforts throughout.

 Just $8–$11 Uber to Broadway, with free private garage parking and easy self check-in for a seamless stay.

The space
This modern, spacious townhome is designed for comfort, connection, and enjoying Nashville together. The open-concept layout makes it easy to cook, relax, and gather, while multiple outdoor spaces give everyone room to spread out.

WHAT GUESTS LOVE
• Huge private rooftop with downtown skyline views
• Large rooftop sectional seating and outdoor TV
• Sleeps up to 10 guests comfortably
• Private 2-car garage (rare in Nashville)
• Super-fast Wi-Fi and smart TVs
• Easy self check-in with smart lock

THE SPACE
Main Living Area:
Bright, open living room with comfortable seating, a fully equipped kitchen with a large island, and a spacious dining area perfect for group meals.

Outdoor Spaces:
A massive private rooftop with skyline views, sectional seating, and an outdoor TV, plus two additional private balconies.

Sleeping Arrangements:
Bedroom 1: 2 Queen beds + 1 Twin bed
Bedroom 2: 1 Queen bed + 1 Twin bed
Bedroom 3: 1 King bed  1 Twin bed
Additional sleeping via sofa beds in common areas

Bathrooms:
Clean, modern bathrooms with spa-style rain shower, plush towels, premium shampoo and body wash, and hairdryers provided.

Guest access
Guests have private, exclusive access to the entire home, including the rooftop and balconies. Self check-in with smart lock and private 2-car garage included.

Other things to note
This is a city townhome designed for groups enjoying Nashville. The rooftop is a highlight, please be mindful of quiet hours in the evening. Starter essentials are provided, and smart TVs are ready for your personal streaming accounts.
